name: Kanban
description: 项目看板：同一项目的所有会话共享，人和会话都能创建、编辑、拖动卡片。

agentTools.name: kanban_list
agentTools.description: List the columns and cards of the current project's shared kanban board. Shared across sessions of this project.

agentTools.name: kanban_upsert
agentTools.description: Create a card (omit id) or update/move an existing card (pass id) on the project's shared kanban board. Use it to track tasks and report progress visible to the user and other sessions.

id.description: Card id to update; omit to create

column.description: Column id or name; defaults to the first column on create

bind.description: true binds the card to the calling session, false unbinds. New cards are bound to the calling session by default.

agentTools.name: kanban_column
agentTools.description: Manage board columns: add (name, optional index), rename (id, name), delete (id; must be empty), move (id, index).

agentTools.name: kanban_delete
agentTools.description: Delete a card from the project's kanban board.
